name: X Weigh-in
description: Weigh in on your watch in seconds. Your weights stay on the watch, and the trend shows where you are heading beneath the day-to-day swings.

configFields.label: Waypoint name
configFields.description: Shown on the watch while you navigate. Letters, digits and spaces only.
configFields.validationMessage: Up to 16 letters, digits and spaces.

configFields.label: Target latitude
configFields.description: Latitude of the waypoint in decimal degrees. North is positive.

configFields.label: Target longitude
configFields.description: Longitude of the waypoint in decimal degrees. East is positive.

configFields.label: Arrival radius
configFields.description: How close you need to get before the watch counts you as arrived.

configFields.label: Vibrate on arrival
configFields.description: Buzz the watch once when you come within the arrival radius of the target.
